title: Best Cutting Board (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by reviewing Tom’s Guide, CNET, and Yahoo! Shopping articles that list and test cutting boards.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a home cook who needs a sturdy board for daily meal prep. The John Boos maple board offers a solid surface that holds up to knife cuts and is easy to clean. Its main catch is that it is not dishwasher‑safe.
